cells.gaps: No source found says what share of Takaful and Karama payments go to cards, or whether the other programmes using the registry pay digitally.
cells.note: The registry is linked to 27 databases by national ID number in November 2026 (EGY-004), and Takaful and Karama, which selects from it, pays through Meeza cards (EGY-005), so 5.
